US Politics and Iran Tensions Dominate International Coverage

Coverage from various Indian outlets focuses on former US President Donald Trump and Iran's geopolitical stance. Trump's potential actions regarding US elections and his engagement with the mining industry are noted. Simultaneously, Iran has adopted a more robust military posture, vowing to keep the Strait of Hormuz closed until US sanctions end, indicating a readiness for prolonged regional conflict.
